- `rate-limit` adds a `[ratelimit]` section to config.toml and adds the `over_limit` function
- `oauth-refresh` adds an `[oauth]` section to config.toml and adds the `refresh_if_needed` function

1. Create a new commit with both rate-limit and oauth-refresh as parents (a merge commit in git terms)
2. When there's a conflict (both modified config.toml), I need to resolve it to keep both blocks
